indications.trial_design: Randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind, multiple ascending dose in early AD
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting; fully enrolled. Tau PET imaging readout expected H2 2026.
key_milestones: H2 2026: Tau PET imaging data readout

excluded_preclinical: VY1706 (tau silencing AAV gene therapy, AD/tauopathies) — IND-enabling; clinical initiation expected 2026
GBA1 gene therapy (Parkinson's / Lewy Body Dementia / Gaucher) — IND-enabling under Neurocrine collaboration
Friedreich's Ataxia (FA) frataxin AAV gene therapy — IND-enabling under Neurocrine collaboration
TRACER capsid platform / additional CNS programs — preclinical
excluded_legacy_terminated: VY-AADC01 / VY-AADC02 (Parkinson's, AAV2-hAADC) — Neurocrine-led trials NCT01973543, NCT03065192, NCT03562494 all COMPLETED; program no longer Voyager-controlled
VY9323 (SOD1 ALS gene therapy) — discontinued in Feb 2025 due to off-target siRNA payload findings; Voyager pursuing alternate payload
excluded_partner_owned: GBA1 and FA gene therapy programs are partnered with Neurocrine Biosciences (license/collaboration); listed as preclinical under partner-led IND filing path
